channel.title: Local News Wire Broadcast Feed
channel.description: Approved local stories in broadcast order

item.description: Twenty-eight officers graduated from the Vermont Police Academy in Rutland. Graduate Griffin Melen will join the Rutland City Police Department next week.

Friends of Castleton Parks raised one hundred thousand dollars for a new gym floor. Installation starts November thirtieth and finishes by January first. The rec center building is owned by the town and partially leased to Vermont Sports Medicine Center.

Quarry Valley School Board reviewed a second draft of its fiscal year twenty twenty-eight budget. Education spending is projected to rise by four point two percent, with health insurance premiums adjusted to a two point five percent increase. The board approved a ten thousand dollar capital improvement for Proctor schools and will meet again in December.

The butternut tree was expected to nearly disappear from Vermont by twenty twelve due to disease. Martin Kratt found hundreds of young and mature butternut trees on his Isle La Motte property. Researchers are now studying these trees to learn how they are surviving.
